en.name: Dispatch Order! Rescue-ACE!
en.effect:
You can only use this Skill's second and third effects once per Duel.
1: Any effect damage your card effects would inflict on your opponent becomes 0, and during your Main Phase, you can only Normal or Special Summon "Rescue-ACE" monsters (excluding Special Summons from the Extra Deck).
2: Reveal 1 Level 6 or higher "Rescue-ACE" monster in your hand. Shuffle 1 card from your hand into your Deck, and add up to 2 "Rescue-ACE" cards from your Deck to your hand.
3: If only your opponent controls a monster, play 1 "Rescue-ACE Hydrant" from your hand or Deck, and Set 1 "Rescue-ACE" Spell/Trap Card from your hand or Deck to your field. (This card can be activated the same turn.)
